text.tspan: The 12 levels in four stages (an arrow means: finish this level first)
✅ written (green) · 🚧 partly written, 1 of 9 lessons (orange) · 📝 planned (dashed) · Mx = the milestone the level counts towards
No arrow between two levels: study them in any order. 💸 = the only level whose labs will use a paid cloud account.
Times are estimates: Levels 1–3 about 38 h · all 12 levels about 190 h · with interview preparation about 200 h
